inputs.text: [pained] It's round my wrist. Don't pull me that way, it's tightening. I can't get the wand up.
[urgent] I'm not pulling your arm. I'm trying to keep you on your feet. Let your elbow come down. You're fighting it and it's getting tighter.
[pained] I can feel it getting tighter. I don't know how I'm supposed to let it take my arm without losing the wand.
[urgent] Keep your fingers closed. Let me take your weight for a step. I can get my heel on the line if you give me a little room.
[pained] I thought it was going to break it. I could feel it pulling right up to my shoulder.
[urgent] Can you open your fingers? Slowly. I'm not asking you to pretend it doesn't hurt. I need to know if you can still hold the wand.
[pained] Draconia, the armor behind you. Don't turn toward it. There's a trolley beside your left foot.
